WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT p.sku, f.net_amount AS net, f.quantity AS qty
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND w.dispatch_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.quantity_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
)
SELECT n.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand, ROUND(SUM(n.net),2) AS web_net_sales, SUM(n.qty) AS units
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC LIMIT 14

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
mine AS (
  SELECT sum(x) v FROM (
  SELECT f.net_amount x FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
   WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND w.dispatch_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
   WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date >= DATE '2025-11-03')
)
SELECT (SELECT v FROM mine) mine, (SELECT sum(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900 AND business_date>=DATE '2025-11-03') ctrl,
 (SELECT max(business_date) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900) ctrl_max,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_product WHERE category='ZZ Test') ztest_versions,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT product_name FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_names
